parole.significato: rumen, paunch, the first compartment of the stomach of a ruminant
parole.testo: Ultimately from Vulgar Latin *umbulīcus. First attested in the 19th century. See also Romanian burtă (“belly”), for which the same etymon is alleged.
From Vulgar Latin buttia. Doublet of bȍca and bȁčva.
